I'm hearing from my friends at OpenAI that the vibes ARE DOWN. Like almost depressed. This might be the worst week in the company's history type bad.



Tuesday was supposed to be their big day. They launched GPT-6.2 and at the same time dozens of early testers dropped the worst reviews imaginable. Theo's review got more views than the launch post. This went even worse than the GPT-5 launch.



Then Google chose violence and dropped the opposite of a GPT model with Neon. It's conversational, understands intent, very good at coding/3D and brought them back to the top. A lot of people say they already passed OpenAI. And the worst thing: Nano 🍌 Pro 2 is currently in the arena and the outputs are stunning. So Google basically overtook OpenAI in a single week.



For months OpenAI tried to pretend to be the best lab by bullying mathematicians and burning massive amounts of compute on Navier-Stokes (and countless other math problems). Now Anthropic mogged them by solving the Riemann Hypothesis and makes OpenAI look like an undergrad while they are doing 250k-page alien math.



The last funding round was a disaster too. They wanted $30B at $1.5T. They got $15B at $1.25T. They lost $10.9B last quarter, so this money only lasts them ~4 months. They are basically cooked and the valuation will likely drop further.



OpenAI isn't the best at anything anymore. They might genuinely be done.

◆【影に咲く花・銃】を装備すると、ニキは影に身を委ね、短銃による5連続攻撃を素早く繰り出し、鳴転エネルギーを蓄積できます。鳴転エネルギーが最大になると、影の棘を召喚して敵を攻撃し、影の刃を放ちます。影の刃は、影の棘が命中した敵を優先して追撃します。また、パーフェクト回避後に攻撃を繰り出すと、影の光芒を召喚して敵を攻撃することもできます。スキル【星に響く】を使用すると、影と力を合わせ、一筋の闇を放ち、長い夜を貫き、敵に大ダメージを与えます。【千蝶の夢】を装備すると、無数の帷の蝶を集め、範囲内の敵に継続ダメージを与えるとともに、行動を制限する効果を付与できます。特殊銃装【千蝶の夢】は、ほかの銃にも装備できます。

開けた場所に置くことができます。

古い木々が絵の世界から枝を伸ばし、深い紫の彩りが額縁を越えてあふれ出す。蝶の影は木陰と淡い光の間を軽やかに行き交う。旅する少女もかつてここに立ち止まった。彼女はいつも、最も暗い色の中に、まだ描かれていない明日を見いだしていた。
